name: MCP-Atlas
intro: MCP-Atlas 是一个面向生产级 MCP 工具使用的大规模基准，包含 36 个真实服务器、220 个工具和 1,000 个专家编写任务。任务不泄露服务器、工具或参数，并加入语义相近干扰项；最终答案按基于工具输出的原子声明覆盖率评分。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工与自动质检
metric: 声明覆盖率, 通过率
eval_feature: 多轮, 结果导向, 动态, 实时
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human and Automated QA
intro_en: MCP-Atlas is a large-scale benchmark for production MCP tool use with 36 real servers, 220 tools, and 1,000 expert-authored tasks. Prompts reveal no server, tool, or parameter names and include semantically plausible distractors; final answers are scored by coverage of atomic claims grounded in tool outputs.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Benchmark Construction
        A[Task Design & Goal Setting] --> B(1000 Tasks, 3-6 Tool Calls, Multi-Server, Conditional Logic)
        B --> C[Environment Setup: 36 Real MCP Servers, 220 Tools]
    end

    subgraph Task Schema Definition
        C --> D[1. Tool Set Configuration: 10-25 Tools/Task, 3-7 Target, 5-10 Distractors]
        D --> E[2. Prompt Creation: Natural Language, Multi-Hop Reasoning, No Explicit Tool Names]
        E --> F[3. Reference Trajectory: Minimal Tool Call Sequence, Diagnostic Use Only]
        F --> G[4. Claims List: Atomic, Verifiable Claims from Tool Outputs]
    end

    subgraph Quality Assurance
        G --> H[Human Review Layer 1: Domain Expert Review (Correctness, Solvability)]
        H --> I[Human Review Layer 2: Prompt Naturalness Validation (No Tool Name Leakage)]
        I --> J[Automated LLM Verification: Claims List Completeness, Trajectory Consistency]
        J --> K[Quality Control Samples: Random Manual Review for Systematic Issues]
    end

    subgraph Evaluation Methodology
        K --> L[Claim Verification: Agent Answer vs. Claims List (Fulfilled, Partially, Not)]
        L --> M[Coverage Scoring: Average Claim Scores (1, 0.5, 0)]
        M --> N{Pass/Fail Determination: Coverage Score >= 0.75 Threshold}
    end

    N -- Pass --> O[Benchmark Dataset Release (500-Task Public Subset)]
    N -- Fail --> P[Diagnostic Analysis & Iteration]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select and containerize 36 production servers exposing 220 tools"] --> B["Experts author 1,000 prompts without server, tool, or parameter names"]
    B --> C["Expose 6-37 tools with only 2-8 relevant and plausible distractors"]
    C --> D["Execute reference trajectories and write atomic claim rubrics"]
    D --> E["Apply five QA layers and randomly split 500 public / 500 private"]
    E --> F["Run agents under matched prompts, tool sets, budgets, and final-answer rules"]
    F --> G["Three judges score claims as 1, 0.5, or 0 and average coverage"]
    G --> H["Pass at coverage at least 0.75 and diagnose failures with 11 categories"]

flowchart LR
    A["选择并容器化 36 个生产级服务器及其 220 个工具"] --> B["专家编写 1,000 个不泄露服务器、工具或参数名的任务"]
    B --> C["每题暴露 6-37 个工具，其中仅 2-8 个相关并加入可信干扰项"]

    E --> F["在相同提示、工具集、预算和最终答案规则下运行智能体"]
    F --> G["三个评判器按 1、0.5、0 评分声明并计算平均覆盖率"]
    G --> H["覆盖率至少 0.75 即通过并用 11 类体系诊断失败"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.00933v3, Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendices B, D, and J. The paper builds 1,000 expert-authored tasks over 36 production MCP servers and 220 tools; containerizes and version-pins servers; hides server, tool, and parameter names; exposes 6-37 tools with only 2-8 relevant and semantically plausible distractors; uses reference trajectories only for solvability, tool-dependence checks, and diagnostics; writes atomic claim lists; applies five QA layers; randomly splits 500 public and 500 private tasks; and passes a task only when three-judge final-answer claim coverage reaches 0.75.
